title: The Semester of Route 9
author: Marguerite Blackwood
blurb: Edmund Voss, the only out kid in a town of nine hundred, has spent twelve years being so careful it hurts. Then the school's legendary ghost starts leaving notes addressed by name — in impossible ink — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must expose what the school board buried, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
